handoffPrompt: Open this Studio URL, read its linked agent-setup.json, explain any MCP configuration change before applying it, restart the agent client when instructed, then verify WebMCP with get_capabilities before editing the print form.

codex.installCommand: codex mcp add chrome-devtools -- npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@1.6.0 --isolated=true --categoryExperimentalWebmcp=true --chromeArg=--enable-features=WebMCP,DevToolsWebMCPSupport '--allowedUrlPattern=https://yapweijun1996.github.io/printform-js/*' --usageStatistics=false --performanceCrux=false
codex.restartInstruction: Restart the Codex CLI process or Codex desktop app so its MCP tool list is reloaded.

claudeCode.installCommand: claude mcp add --scope user chrome-devtools -- npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@1.6.0 --isolated=true --categoryExperimentalWebmcp=true --chromeArg=--enable-features=WebMCP,DevToolsWebMCPSupport '--allowedUrlPattern=https://yapweijun1996.github.io/printform-js/*' --usageStatistics=false --performanceCrux=false
claudeCode.restartInstruction: Restart Claude Code so its MCP tool list is reloaded.

procedure.instruction: Read this entire manifest and select the matching client entry. Do not guess flags or use an unpinned package version.
Run the client detection command and the applicable Node and Chrome version checks. Report missing prerequisites before changing configuration.
Run inspectCommand. If chrome-devtools already exists, compare its command and args with mcpServer.
Before removing or replacing an existing user-scoped MCP server, explain the exact difference and obtain user approval. Skip removal when no conflicting entry exists.
When approved, run removeCommand only if required, then run installCommand. Verify the resulting entry with inspectCommand.
Ask the user to follow restartInstruction. Do not claim WebMCP is ready until the restarted client exposes Chrome DevTools MCP tools.
Call new_page with the Studio URL.
Call list_webmcp_tools and require all expected Studio tools before editing.
Execute get_capabilities and verify the protocol and command contract versions.
